name: Stewards Summer Camp
description_short: An outdoor day program for grades 6-8 where campers learn about coastal ecosystems and how people affect them. Each week has a theme, with field trips, tide pooling, kayaking and beach stewardship around the NH, ME and MA coast.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel more than two weeks before your child's first day of camp and you get a 50% refund. After that, no refunds.
swim_waterfront_notes: The program includes kayaking (Session C, with Monday-Tuesday for beginners and Wednesday-Friday for experienced paddlers), surfing, stand-up paddle boarding and snorkeling (Session E), and boat trips. The camp provides all equipment. A kayak waiver is required. Swim test requirements are not stated.

Session B: Coastal Habitats of Odiorne Point State Park (by the week)
Session C: Coastal Kayaking (by the day or week)

Session E: Eco-Sport Week (by the week)
Session F: Eco-Trips II (by the day or week)

warnings: This page shows the 2026 season (June 22 to August 14, 2026), which has already happened as of today (2026-10-13). No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.

Prices depend on membership: $475/week for members and $525/week for non-members. Daily rates are $95 for members and $105 for non-members (Sessions A, C, D and F only). price_per_week shows the non-member rate. Session prices are left blank because they depend on membership.
Paying by credit card adds a 3% processing fee.
The member rate needs a qualifying membership (6-Star, or Family or higher if bought after 12/31/25) that is valid through the camp dates.
Two phone numbers appear: 603-812-9425 (Camp Director during camp) and 603-436-8043 (main line, ext. 16 for financial aid).
